value.rationale: The optimal monotone-data safety margin for the smallest genuinely bivariate quadratic tensor-grid interpolation is an intrinsic, fully quantified constrained operator invariant. It distinguishes the exact 17/64 defect from both 1D 1/8 and unconstrained 9/32, with a non-product sign cancellation proof and a natural isotone upper-ideal extremizer. It is useful for robust data-range guarantees on monotone 2D fields; not an arbitrary slice of a parameter table.
